page.overview:
Who is Leyak?

The Leyak is a recruitable monster in Final Fantasy XIII-2. It can be obtained by throwing Mog with the "Improved Moogle Throw" Fragment Skill activated at the two flan in Sunleth Waterscape -300 AF- while riding the giant Enlil. Although it can only be obtained once by using Mog, it can be re-obtained as a drop from Valfodr at level 1.
